$comment: no-tiny-text override for design-system showcase: 10px Micro Label is a documented, sanctioned step of the type scale (see TypeScale.tsx), not an accessibility bug. Suppression approved by Bora 2026-07-12. Scoped to this directory only via ignore.overrides so genuinely-too-small text elsewhere still gets flagged. div+role="button" a11y pattern follows the WTC in-repo precedent; real <button> conversion rejected 2026-07-16 (visual-locked DS, nested-interactive semantics); keyboard parity implemented via onKeyDown. 2026-08-01 (PR #59): render-helper no-render-in-render suppressed on Calendar/WorkflowAddElements (visual-locked flagship, child-component conversion risks key/animation regressions); no-long-transition-duration suppressed on DynamicIslandReader (1800ms diShine is a deliberate infinite ambient shimmer, not a one-shot transition); use-lazy-motion suppressed on DragDismissSheet (sole framer-motion consumer in the DS, LazyMotion provider not worth it for one showcase component); DragDismissSheet added to prefer-tag-over-role list for the decorative full-bleed scrim role=button. design-system/preview/** excluded by user decision 2026-08-18; those files are browser-Babel prototypes behind static HTML preview pages, not shipped application code, and feedback item F1 targeted apps/web/src/**; React Doctor's unused-file rule wrongly reports them dead because it traces ES module imports and cannot see the <script type="text/babel" src=...> tags at components-leads-table.html:99 and components-task-card.html:867; the scan-scope key ignore.files is deliberately NOT used because on the CI-pinned react-doctor 0.5.8 it corrupts whole-project analysis and drops 33 unrelated findings and 2 errors from apps/web/src even when its glob matches nothing (fixed in 0.9.12, which is not what .github/workflows/react-doctor.yml pins); six unused-file findings survive this override because that rule is project-level, and all six are confirmed false positives accepted as documented exceptions. 2026-08-22: ignore.files is now used for design-system/preview/**, design-system/tools/**, and eslint-rules/** because 0.9.12 fixed the whole-project corruption bug that made ignore.files unsafe on the CI-pinned 0.5.8. 2026-08-22: the TaskBoard giant-component-size override is removed; the reorder logic duplicated across onDrop/undoMove/syncMove moved to task-board-reducer.ts (pure, no refs/timers), bringing the component body under the 300-line threshold without touching state, refs, or animation wiring.
